task.description:
Validate that DDL-05, MIG-01, MIG-02, MIG-03 (all MUST) meet all acceptance criteria and NFRs before release. All prior gates (design validation, security review, test design validation, test execution) have PASSED. Confirm every MUST requirement has passing integration test evidence in the current test report -- no deferred coverage. This batch introduces no new HTTP endpoints (MIG-04/05/06's admin surface is a separate later batch), so standard HTTP-level NFR benchmarks (latency/throughput) are not applicable; focus on: migration correctness (zig build migrate idempotent, applies cleanly), test coverage completeness against requirements.yaml AC lists, and confirm the MIG-01 AC1 gap TEST-DESIGNER found and closed is genuinely covered now.

RE-VALIDATION (after REWORK 1): TEST-DESIGNER added TC-MIG-02-04 (genuine pool_size=2 exhaustion, no mock) closing the MIG-02 AC4 coverage gap you identified. TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR re-validated PASS. TEST-RUNNER re-ran and confirmed test-integration-mig02-mig03 is now 9/9 (was 8/8), report updated at tests/reports/report-20260811-WF02-batch-0.yaml. Re-check MIG-02 AC4 specifically has real test evidence now, and re-confirm the rest of your original findings still hold.
acceptance_criteria: All MUST requirement ACs have passing integration test evidence in tests/reports/report-20260811-WF02-batch-0.yaml
No deferred/skipped coverage on any MUST requirement
Migration idempotency confirmed (re-running zig build migrate is a clean no-op)

result.summary: RE-VALIDATION after REWORK 1: MIG-02 AC4 coverage gap independently re-verified as genuinely closed. Read TC-MIG-02-04 in tests/integration/migration_fanout_test.zig and the production code it exercises (src/platform/migration_fanout.zig applyToTenant/recordFailureSeparately) line-by-line; confirmed the dedicated pool_size=2 Pool technique produces a real PoolError.ExhaustedPool (src/db/pool.zig, no mock) inside recordFailureSeparately, and the control row is asserted to stay exactly at seeded pending status -- matching AC4 verbatim. Read updated tests/specs/MIG-02.md: no more not-directly-tested/deferral language. Independently re-ran zig build test-integration-mig02-mig03 --summary all myself (env vars set explicitly) and confirmed 9/9 tests passed, exit 0, matching the test report. Re-ran zig build migrate twice and reconfirmed idempotent no-op. All other original findings (DDL-05, MIG-01, MIG-03 coverage; HTTP NFR not applicable to this batch) re-affirmed unchanged. Release decision updated from BLOCKED to APPROVED.
